objective: Record acceptance of the P1-P6 product-scope audit after executable evidence completed.

baseline.status: Product Scope Audit, Scientific Validation, CodeQL, and PR CI passed on the audited revision.

correctness.before: P1-P6 scope had implementation evidence but no unified acceptance record

reliability.before: product-scope completion was not a single release gate
reliability.after: dedicated audit workflow passed and is retained

reproducibility.after: workflow run and exact audited revision are recorded

evidence: PR CI run 37321993505 passed all gated stages.

root_causes: The audit process caught and corrected invalid lifecycle-record drafts before acceptance.

findings: The cumulative lifecycle validator must remain release-blocking.
P1-P6 completion requires executable current-revision evidence rather than source inspection alone.
